syn: apt [-h] [-o=config_string] [-c=config_file] [-t=target_release] [-a=architecture] {list | search | show | update | install pkg [{=pkg_version_number | /target_release}]... | remove pkg... | upgrade | full-upgrade | edit-sources | {-v | --version} | {-h | --help}}

update.es: Actualiza la LISTA de paquetes disponibles (no instala nada).
update.en: Refresh the LIST of available packages (installs nothing).

upgrade.es: Instala las versiones nuevas de los paquetes ya instalados (sin quitar ni añadir otros).
upgrade.en: Install newer versions of installed packages (without removing or adding others).

full-upgrade.es: Actualiza todo, pudiendo añadir o quitar paquetes si hace falta.
full-upgrade.en: Upgrade everything, adding or removing packages if needed.

dist-upgrade.es: Actualiza todo, pudiendo añadir o quitar paquetes si hace falta.
dist-upgrade.en: Upgrade everything, adding or removing packages if needed.

remove.es: Desinstala paquetes (deja los archivos de configuración).

purge.es: Desinstala paquetes Y borra sus archivos de configuración.
purge.en: Remove packages AND delete their config files.

autoremove.es: Quita las dependencias que ya no necesita nadie.
autoremove.en: Remove dependencies no longer needed by anything.

autoclean.es: Limpia la caché de paquetes descargados.
autoclean.en: Clean the cache of downloaded packages.

clean.es: Limpia la caché de paquetes descargados.
clean.en: Clean the cache of downloaded packages.

search.es: Busca paquetes por nombre o descripción.
search.en: Search packages by name or description.

show.es: Muestra la información de un paquete.

policy.es: Muestra versiones disponibles y de dónde vienen.
policy.en: Show available versions and where they come from.

tip.es: «apt update» refresca la lista; «apt upgrade» instala las novedades. Son dos pasos distintos.
tip.en: "apt update" refreshes the list; "apt upgrade" installs the news. They are two different steps.

o.es: Responde «sí» a todo: no pide confirmación.
o.en: Assume yes to all prompts: no confirmation.

o.es: Simula sin instalar ni quitar nada.
o.en: Simulate without installing or removing anything.
Show audit (and notice) messages. This overrides the quiet option, but only for notice messages, not progress ones.

Configuration File; Specify a configuration file to use. The program will read the default configuration file and then this configuration file. If configuration settings need to be set before the default configuration files are parsed specify a file with the APT_CONFIG environment variable.
Set a Configuration Option; This will set an arbitrary configuration option. The syntax is -o Foo::Bar=bar. -o and --option can be used multiple times to set different options.
Requests a specific CLI version. This is a pattern that takes a MAJOR.MINOR version. You may omit the MINOR version, in which case the latest supported minor level will be used.

Turn colors on or off. Colors are on by default on supported terminals for apt(8) and can also be disabled using the NO_COLOR or APT_NO_COLOR environment variables, or further configured by the APT::Color configuration option and scope, see apt.conf(5) for information on that.
